name: Luigi Mangione
description: Follow Luigi Mangione, a tracked organization, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Mangione may reach a plea deal in his federal case. Here's what it means for his state charges
changes.summary: Luigi Mangione, the man accused of killing UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson, is expected in court on Friday for a special hearing that could include a potential plea deal on federal stalking charges. Tom Hanson has more.

changes.title: Luigi Mangione's potential plea deal in federal trial sparks double jeopardy concern
changes.summary: Luigi Mangione, the man accused of killing UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson in New York City, is expected in federal court as sources say he may plea guilty. Legal analyst Joe Tamburino joins with more details about the questions concerning the future of his New York state trial.

changes.title: Luigi Mangione expected to plead guilty during Manhattan federal court hearing
changes.summary: Mangione was charged with two federal stalking counts and faces a maximum penalty of life in prison in the 2024 killing of United Healthcare CEO Brian Thompson.

changes.title: Luigi Mangione pleads guilty in federal case, admits shooting UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson
changes.summary: Luigi Mangione entered a guilty plea in his federal case at a court appearance in Manhattan Friday morning.

changes.title: Luigi Mangione tells judge of ‘intent to shoot Brian Thompson’
changes.summary: Luigi Mangione told a federal judge that he “shot Mr. Thompson in Manhattan in the back,” adding that he understood his actions and knew what he was doing.

changes.title: Luigi Mangione in discussions about possible guilty plea in federal case, sources tell CBS News
changes.summary: Luigi Mangione, accused in the 2024 killing of UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson, is in discussions about a possible plea deal on federal charges, sources familiar with the matter told CBS News.

changes.title: Luigi Mangione to appear in court for expected guilty plea in killing of UnitedHealthcare CEO
changes.summary: Luigi Mangione is scheduled to be in federal court Friday for a hearing at which he's expected to plead guilty in connection with the 2024 killing of UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson, according to a person familiar with the matter.

changes.title: Mangione could plead guilty in federal case ahead of N.Y. murder trial
changes.summary: A surprise hearing this Friday in federal court has added to speculation that Luigi Mangione could enter a plea, which could derail a state murder trial. (Image credit: Steven Hirsch).

changes.title: Luigi Mangione, Facing Stalking Charges in Federal Court, Is Expected to Plead Guilty
changes.summary: He is charged with stalking resulting in the death of an executive, but the specifics of his plea were unclear. A murder trial in state court is set for next month.
